entities.name: Sheikh Hasina's Awami League
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Sheikh Hasina's Awami League, a political institution in Bangladesh during Democratic Era and Economic Transformation (1991–2009). Grew from Democracy Movement of 1990. Led to the emergence of Two-Party Democracy and Garment Boom and Rana Plaza garment factory collapse kills over 1,100 workers.
